title: A methylation motif census
description: Published counts of tested and detected modifications for five unambiguous single-motif rows. This exploration compares motif-level prevalence; it does not fabricate a chromosome-wide modification track.
processing: Transcribe the unique GATC, ACCACC, ATGCAT, CTGCAG and CCWGG Table 1 occurrence/detection counts; compute exact detected/tested ×100. Deduplicate GATC rows referring to the same count; omit the two-part motif row whose denominator needs separate treatment.
limits: These are motif-level published aggregates, not individual modification-site coordinates.
Single-site processed calls were not retrieved for this prototype.
The ATGCAT row is reported inactive in the source; zero is a real published detection count.
Detection is thresholded evidence of kinetic variation, not a literal molecule-by-molecule methylation fraction.
